description: The chart titled “Factual Errors” illustrates the number of factual errors across four QA datasets for three methods. The horizontal axis contains the category labels HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is a linear numeric scale ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks at regular 5-unit intervals. Each category shows a grouped set of three vertical bars corresponding to the legend: NoR QA (orange), OneR QA (red), and IRCoT QA (blue). For HotpotQA, the bars are labeled 15 (orange NoR QA), 10 (red OneR QA), and 5 (blue IRCoT QA). For 2WikiMQA, the bars are 29 (orange), 23 (red), and 14 (blue). For MuSiQue, the bars are 28 (orange), 27 (red), and 23 (blue). For IIRC, the bars are 15 (orange), 14 (red), and 11 (blue). The bars are not shown as stacked; they are arranged side-by-side within each dataset group, with numeric value annotations above each bar, and there is no visual indication that the groups are sorted by bar height beyond the fixed dataset order.
